title: So, so glad I got to revisit Beau before it closes Aug 3 #offbroadway...
transcript: you have one more week to go see Beau at out of the box theatrics and if you haven't already what are you doing I really love this show I was lucky enough to be invited to go see this in previews but I really wanted to go back later in its run and I'm I I'm so glad I did but it was an original musical by Douglas Lyons and Ethan Pakchar that is framed like a concert of a young man who returns to his hometown with his band and tells the story of his time growing up there and you know learning about his queer identity and connecting with his grandfather who he didn't know existed until he was 12 years old and I really love how multiple timelines are woven into the story and in fact this this uh composition notebook sheet is actually a full timeline of the show that they give you now which I did not have the first time but you have the overarching framing device of this concert and in this concert framing device you have ah flashbacks to the 1970s and the concerts that Ace's grandfather Beau was having in the 1970s you also have ace growing up in the 90s slash early 2000s the first time I saw this show did not have this timeline at all but they did a really great job of establishing what time periods we were in like you knew that both the past which took place in the 1970s because of like very simple costume design the choreography that they do and same with the 90s timeline that was always very clear to me and again I think a lot of that has to do with the costume design which I think does a great job of establishing time period a lot of that also just has to do with the way that they talk and maybe that's because I grew up in the 90s and it was all it all felt very familiar and even though the entire show takes place in this unit distillery set up because that's where the concert is taking place the props also feel very rooted in the time period that they're in when I saw this the first time one of the things that I really wished even though I loved the music and I loved the story I wanted it to have that emotional gut punch that I felt like they were going for and tonight I absolutely felt that and that really is a testament to how much shows can improve when they get past their preview period and I'm always one for seeing shows in the preview period if I had it my way I would see every show at the beginning of previews and then again like closing week which is basically what I did with this show because to me there's something so thrilling about getting to see a show throughout its development to see where it starts and where it ends up and I don't know how much of this show they rewrote from the first time I saw it to the second time but the way that the entire show felt so much tighter and those emotional scenes at the end hit me in a way that I wanted them to hit me the first time and really really absolutely hit me tonight and I think especially as a performer once you really get to sit with the show past the preview period past the period where you're making changes each day and you really get to find those characters and live in those moments that's when the show starts to connect in a way that it doesn't always necessarily in the preview period and I again I love this show the first time I saw it but tonight I really saw what this show has become and it's beautiful if you have a chance please go see the show I think it's a beautiful piece of queer storytelling it's a beautiful original musical you have this incredible cast of actor musicians who are all on that stage singing their freaking faces off and playing instruments at the same time and really embodying these characters as far as tickets go like I said the first time I was invited the second time I today I did the TodayTix rush and got the front centre table in the front row so I've only sat at the table seats for this the table seats are great I kind of wish I'd gotten to see it from further back but the table seats are absolutely fantastic you really become immersed in the show they're all around and you and as a bonus if you get the table seats you do get a free drink at the bar on the stage uh and I even though I got a TodayTix to rush ticket today I still got that free drink so you know plus I think it's like totally random of whatever seats are left in the house but that's the seat I got today Beau was able to extend a couple times but it does close on August 3rd so please go see it this week before it closes on Sunday out of the box Theatrics is then moving locations so they're no longer gonna be doing shows in the space which is too bad I absolutely love the space on Christopher Street but I really hope that we have not seen the last of this show I just think it's great I really enjoy it every time I go and uh if you haven't gone definitely check it out
